item.$description: Breadcrumb items are rendered by the owning trail and share its tokens.

bg.$description: Transparent backing for ancestor text and the overflow trigger.

fg.$description: Medium-emphasis ink for ancestors and the overflow trigger, strengthened in more-contrast mode.

current-bg.$description: Transparent backing for the current level.

current-fg.$description: Emphasized foreground of the current level.

separator.$description: Foreground of the decorative breadcrumb chevron.

gap.$description: Gap between breadcrumb rows, levels and their chevrons.

padding-inline.$description: Inline inset of a level label.

padding-block.$description: Block inset of a level label.

radius.$description: Radius of the overflow trigger and level focus outlines.

separator-size.$description: Edge length of the decorative chevron before rotation.

separator-stroke.$description: Stroke width of the decorative chevron.

hover-bg.$description: Backing for the active overflow trigger and highlighted overflow links.

hover-fg.$description: Foreground for the active overflow trigger and highlighted overflow links.

menu-bg.$description: Surface behind the overflow menu entries.

menu-bg-image.$description: Optional image layered over the overflow menu surface.

menu-backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter of the overflow menu, none by default.

menu-padding.$description: Inset around the overflow menu entries.

menu-radius.$description: Outer radius of the overflow menu.

menu-shadow.$description: Elevation of the overflow menu above the page.

menu-max-block-size.$description: Maximum block size of the scrollable overflow menu.
